interpretation.DIRECT_PRIOR_PROVENANCE_SOURCE_LINK: Same archived LMD source ID or archived LMD URL is already attached to one CL2 physical site; NOT current site/schedule verification
interpretation.OLD_NAME_ONLY_SUGGESTION_UNVERIFIED: Historical source matcher named an existing source ID but building/locality identity has NOT been reconciled; do not auto link, edit, or import
interpretation.NO_DIRECT_CL2_PROVENANCE_LINK_NOT_PROVEN: No direct source-ID/URL match; the site may still exist in CL2 from other independent sources. Not proof of absence or false data

policy: The archived 1531 source rows are not the current 1570 positions of the live country aggregate. A numerical difference is not a set of new unique sites.
No direct source id/URL match is proof of currently active 1962 Mass, exact venue or frequency.
Historical automated name-only suggestions are explicitly not accepted as physical-site identity; duplicate church dedications and different cities produce false positives.
Never treat an Ad Orientem-only site as wrong because LMD excludes SSPX and has a different mission.
No LMD venue text or schedules copied: only existing source IDs, country codes and original CL2 IDs appear here.
Every new site proposal still requires independent institutional physical-location evidence and Excel CL2 approval.

locality_screen.token_normalisation: NFKD lowercased word tokens, generic country/liturgical/address terms ignored
locality_screen.candidate_rule: Same country, >=2 non-generic church-name tokens, >=0.78 both name coverage and rarity-weighted coverage, >=1 distinct locale token in canonical address rare across CL2 (at most 15 sites).
locality_screen.collision_policy: Two or more equally ranked top CL2 IDs held. All textual matches held pending first-party physical-site proof. Discrepant old name-only suggestions not carried forward as identity.
warnings: Church name + matching city is a research hint, not verified same physical church entrance or current 1962-Missal celebration.
Canonical address can be locality-only and unverified; matched city text does not improve geographic precision.
This algorithm does not exhaust unlinked LMD sources and does not fetch any current LMD profile.
No automatic admission, pin, schedule or CL27 claim is permitted.

exact_shared_firstparty_source_screen.notes: These 4 source-owner URL relationships have no exact source-ID nor LMD-URL match to CL2; the existing provenance classification remains unchanged. Three owners attest older rite, St Stephen's Latin Mass alone does not certify 1962 Missal and location.
